_comment: Measured defects, used as NEGATIVE CONTROLS.
House convention (etc/kie-dmn-check, the zeebe boxed-context tripwire):
every positive control ships a negative sibling, and a negative control that
stops reproducing is itself a finding. So a leg that expects a defect and
does not find it reports BROKEN with an ::error:: telling you to delete the
entry, rather than quietly turning green. A stale negative control is a lie
EVERY entry below was measured on the date it records. Nothing here is
predicted. Groups with no measured entries are empty and say why — the MCP
group in particular, because no jl4-service was reachable when this file was
written and recording unmeasured defects would be exactly the drift this

wizard.note: 406 units in the plan; the keys on every unit are exactly defaultDisposition, heading, id, kind, reachable.

defects.description: `render --format plan` emits no `asks` anywhere: it is a disposition/reachability plan, not the interview query plan the wizard leg needs.
The plan names no inputs, so nothing in it tells an interview what to collect.
No unit carries question text; `heading` is the L4 clause heading, not a question.

mcp.note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. No jl4-service was reachable when this file was written, so no MCP defect has been measured here. etc/go/phases/p7-mcp.sh therefore reports SKIPPED rather than asserting defects it has not seen. Populate this group from a real deployment, not from a prediction.
